summary: The checked-out main source already contains upstream PR #32477 (merge commit ee678910f7000aa43886f218de0e159bf418f1b5): the JIT KV-cache store skips writes to reserved padding slot 0 by default. On gfx950, the default preserved slot 0 under NaN padding inputs, while the explicit opt-out reproduced the old NaN overwrite. No additional product-code correction was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: 358 GPU tests passed, including NaN padding-row preservation for int32/int64 indices and split counts 1/2/4, ordinary non-reserved writes, dtype/shape boundaries, and the reserved-slot opt-out.

tests.command: standalone gfx950 store_cache numerical check recorded in reports/j-bfe220808037/raw/gfx950_reserved_slot_evidence.log
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, default reserved-slot skipping kept K/V slot 0 bit-for-bit unchanged and wrote non-reserved slots exactly; reserved_skip_index=-1 reproduced the former behavior by writing 1024 NaNs into each reserved K/V row.

gpu_execution.evidence: Assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. JIT outputs were generated under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-bfe220808037/cache/sglang_jit/gfx950; paths and SHA-256 checksums are retained in reports/j-bfe220808037/raw/.

remaining_limitations: Official moonshotai/Kimi-K3 and RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark weights were unavailable, so no full model serving run was performed.
Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned; the reported TP=8 NVIDIA Blackwell SM10x/CUDA environment and distributed workload were not reproduced.
Long-context 90k-237k behavior, DSPARK acceptance collapse, SSE [PAD] storms, and the TensorCompare CUDA assertion remain unverified end to end.

The test validates the KV-cache write-side mechanism only; it does not qualify Kimi-K3 tokenizer semantics, model accuracy, or unrelated proposed mitigations such as pad stopping or allowed_special handling.
